title: Sentence check sheet
subject: English
source: Written for english/y2 lesson 87 (Sentence check sheet (printable or typed in the portal))
intro: Lesson 87: Sentence check: four kinds of sentence and joining words. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

head: Word
Example
rows: It rained but we went out.
We hurried because it was late.
We waved when the bus came.

model.title: Write a command about the street

keywords.def: a sentence that tells you something
a sentence that asks; it ends with ?
a sentence that tells you to do something
a sentence that shows surprise; it starts with What or How and ends with !

questions.q: Write a question about a shop
questions.a: For example: When does the shop open?

questions.q: Join with because: We waited. The bus was late.
questions.a: We waited because the bus was late.

questions.q: Add the end mark: How lovely the park is
Core: write one statement, one question and one command about your street
questions.a: For example: My street is long. Is the shop open? Shut the gate.

questions.q: Extend: write an exclamation starting with What or How
questions.a: For example: What a noisy bus!

questions.q: Stretch: write a sentence joined with but and one with when
questions.a: For example: It was cold but we went out. We waved when we saw Gran.

questions.q: What a tall tower that is!
questions.a: C) exclamation. It starts with What, shows surprise and ends with !
